key: SAPHIRA: Throwing in the towel?
en: SAPHIRA: Throwing in the towel?
ja: サファイラ: 白旗を上げるの?

key: ...Pathetic.
en: ...Pathetic.
ja: ……情けない。

key: ADRIENN: \PN!
en: ADRIENN: \PN!
ja: アドリエンヌ: \PN!

key: And from that gym! Thank goodness!
en: And from that gym! Thank goodness!
ja: それも、あのジムから!よかった!

key: We've had no luck reaching anyone up in Calcenon.
en: We've had no luck reaching anyone up in Calcenon.
ja: カルセノンの誰にも連絡がつかなくて。

key: Even Victoria never got back to me after leaving.
en: Even Victoria never got back to me after leaving.
ja: ヴィクトリアも、出発してから一度も連絡がないの。

key: Is everything okay?
en: Is everything okay?
ja: 大丈夫だった?

key: I see...
en: I see...
ja: そう……

key: So it's just like Devon. And that was just a prototype?
en: So it's just like Devon. And that was just a prototype?
ja: それじゃあデボンと同じね。しかもあれはただの試作品だったんでしょう?

key: I'd say I can hardly believe it, but unfortunately, I can.
en: I'd say I can hardly believe it, but unfortunately, I can.
ja: 信じられないと言いたいところだけど、残念ながら信じられてしまうわ。

key: The others-- are they well?
en: The others-- are they well?
ja: 他のみんなは――無事なの?

key: Just Saphira, then.
en: Just Saphira, then.
ja: それじゃあ、サファイラだけなのね。

key: As expected from the highest ranking Leader and our Champion-to-be.
en: As expected from the highest ranking Leader and our Champion-to-be.
ja: さすが最上位のリーダーで、次のチャンピオン候補ね。

key: I cannot approve of going along with Meteor's game, but I know that my comments are far too little and far too late.
en: I cannot approve of going along with Meteor's game, but I know that my comments are far too little and far too late.
ja: メテオの茶番に付き合うなんて、わたしは認められない。でも、今さらこんなことを言っても遅すぎるのよね。

key: I'll make preparations to head there myself and see if I can do anything to help those affected.
en: I'll make preparations to head there myself and see if I can do anything to help those affected.
ja: わたし自身がそちらへ向かう準備をして、被害を受けた人たちに何かできないか見てくるわ。

key: But first, you will be needing advice for Saphira, won't you?
en: But first, you will be needing advice for Saphira, won't you?
ja: でもまずは、サファイラ攻略のアドバイスが必要でしょう?

key: Of course-- One second, please.
en: Of course-- One second, please.
ja: もちろん――少し待っていて。

key: That would have been Monty's Gym, wouldn't it...
en: That would have been Monty's Gym, wouldn't it...
ja: あそこはたしか、モンティのジムだったはずよね……

key: Yes, here it is.
en: Yes, here it is.
ja: ええ、あった。

key: The most threatening feature of the gym is its boost to Dragon Type attacks.
en: The most threatening feature of the gym is its boost to Dragon Type attacks.
ja: このジムでいちばん厄介なのは、ドラゴンタイプの技を強化する効果ね。

key: Due to their boost in power, Saphira is free to invest heavily in Speed. Other moves such as Dragon Dance will also double in power.
en: Due to their boost in power, Saphira is free to invest heavily in Speed. Other moves such as Dragon Dance will also double in power.
ja: 威力が上がるおかげで、サファイラはすばやさに全振りできるの。りゅうのまいのような技も威力が倍になるわ。

key: Dragon Types will also get a boost to both of their Defenses as well.
en: Dragon Types will also get a boost to both of their Defenses as well.
ja: ドラゴンタイプは防御・特防の両方も上がる。

key: These boosts are available to you as well, and if you can make use of them, battles in this gym may become one-sided for either party.
en: These boosts are available to you as well, and if you can make use of them, battles in this gym may become one-sided for either party.
ja: この効果はあなたにも適用されるから、うまく使いこなせれば、このジムでの戦いはどちらか一方に大きく傾くはずよ。

key: Alternatively, a bulky Fairy Type may force her to set up and open a window in which to punish her offensive.
en: Alternatively, a bulky Fairy Type may force her to set up and open a window in which to punish her offensive.
ja: あるいは、耐久のあるフェアリータイプを使えば、彼女に積み技を強要させて、攻めの隙をつくこともできるわ。

key: Not that I'm trying to advertise or anything...
en: Not that I'm trying to advertise or anything...
ja: 別に宣伝してるわけじゃないけど……

key: However, none of these will help when it comes to her ace, Dragonite.
en: However, none of these will help when it comes to her ace, Dragonite.
ja: でも、彼女のエース、カイリューが相手だと、そのどれも役に立たないわ。

key: Its Multiscale ability will negate its Dragon Type weakness regardless of its health,
en: Its Multiscale ability will negate its Dragon Type weakness regardless of its health,
ja: マルチスケイルの特性のおかげで、HPに関係なくドラゴンタイプの弱点が無効化されるし、

key: And the heat of this field will soften Ice Type attacks.
en: And the heat of this field will soften Ice Type attacks.
ja: このフィールドの熱で、こおりタイプの技の威力も抑えられてしまう。

key: Therefore, Rock Type is your only viable choice to hit Dragonite effectively.
en: Therefore, Rock Type is your only viable choice to hit Dragonite effectively.
ja: だから、カイリューに効果的に攻撃できるのは、いわタイプだけよ。

key: Try to save such an attacker for it to reduce its chances to sweep.
en: Try to save such an attacker for it to reduce its chances to sweep.
ja: そういう攻撃役は、カイリューが暴れる可能性を減らすために温存しておくといいわ。

key: If anyone can win this, it's you.
en: If anyone can win this, it's you.
ja: あなたになら、これを勝てるはずよ。

key: This is your final hurdle before properly claiming your championship title!
en: This is your final hurdle before properly claiming your championship title!
ja: チャンピオンの称号を正式に手にする前の、最後の壁ね!

key: I'll be off now, to see what difference I can make up there.
en: I'll be off now, to see what difference I can make up there.
ja: それじゃあわたしは、あちらで何ができるか見てくるわ。

key: Best of luck, Champion.
en: Best of luck, Champion.
ja: 幸運を、チャンピオン。

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: グランドホールでは、誰も応答しないみたいね……

key: SAPHIRA: Welcome to home, sweet home.
en: SAPHIRA: Welcome to home, sweet home.
ja: サファイラ: ようこそ、我が家へ。

key: In a sense.
en: In a sense.
ja: ある意味では、ね。

key: T3RR4: N44444444WH B1SH, TH1S MY H0USE NA0.\tts[TERRA: NAAAAAAAAWH BISH, THIS MY HOUSE Nao.]
en: T3RR4: N44444444WH B1SH, TH1S MY H0USE NA0.\tts[TERRA: NAAAAAAAAWH BISH, THIS MY HOUSE Nao.]
ja: テラ: いんやビッチ、もうここアタシん家だから。\tts[テラ: いや、あんた、もうここはアタシの家だから。]

key: I, THE K1NG OF EV1L, HAVE CLA1MED THIS SACR3D G0LDEN LAND AS MY OWN!\tts[I, THE KING OF EVIL, HAVE CLAIMED THIS SACRED GOLDEN LAND AS MY OWN!]
en: I, THE K1NG OF EV1L, HAVE CLA1MED THIS SACR3D G0LDEN LAND AS MY OWN!\tts[I, THE KING OF EVIL, HAVE CLAIMED THIS SACRED GOLDEN LAND AS MY OWN!]
ja: この悪の王たるアタシが、この神聖なる黄金の地を我が物とした!\tts[この悪の王であるアタシが、この神聖な黄金の地を自分のものにした!]

key: AND W1TH IT, ALL Y0UR b00ty ARE B3LONG TO US!\tts[AND WITH it, ALL YOUR booty ARE BELONG TO us!]
en: AND W1TH IT, ALL Y0UR b00ty ARE B3LONG TO US!\tts[AND WITH it, ALL YOUR booty ARE BELONG TO us!]
ja: そんでもって、テメェらのお宝は全部アタシらのもんだ!\tts[それに、あんたたちの財宝は全部アタシたちのものだ!]

key: RAWWWWWWWWWWRRRRRRR!!!!!!!!!!
en: RAWWWWWWWWWWRRRRRRR!!!!!!!!!!
ja: ラアアアアアアアアアアアアッ!!!!!!!!!!

key: SAPHIRA: And now, I'll show you the best thing about this place.
en: SAPHIRA: And now, I'll show you the best thing about this place.
ja: サファイラ: それじゃあ、ここのいちばんの自慢を見せてあげる。

key: -INTERCOM VOLUME MUTED-
en: -INTERCOM VOLUME MUTED-
ja: -インターコムの音量がミュートされた-

key: SAPHIRA: This gym was built inside the competitive facility for convenience and broadcasting.
en: SAPHIRA: This gym was built inside the competitive facility for convenience and broadcasting.
ja: サファイラ: このジムは、利便性と放送のために競技施設の中に建てられているの。

key: But it would be annoying if a concurrent tournament's announcements played over a private gym battle.
en: But it would be annoying if a concurrent tournament's announcements played over a private gym battle.
ja: でも、個人的なジム戦の最中に、同時開催のトーナメントのアナウンスが流れてきたら邪魔でしょう。

key: This way, we can make sure challenges stay undisturbed.
en: This way, we can make sure challenges stay undisturbed.
ja: こうしておけば、挑戦の邪魔をされずに済むわ。

key: I can't imagine being more thankful for it than I am right now.
en: I can't imagine being more thankful for it than I am right now.
ja: 今ほどこれをありがたいと思ったことはないわね。

key: SAPHIRA: I'll be waiting at the top,
en: SAPHIRA: I'll be waiting at the top,
ja: サファイラ: 頂上で待っているわ。

key: But there are things you must understand first.
en: But there are things you must understand first.
ja: でもその前に、理解してもらわなきゃいけないことがある。

key: SAPHIRA: What is most precious to you?
en: SAPHIRA: What is most precious to you?
ja: サファイラ: あなたにとって、いちばん大切なものは何?

key: SAPHIRA: Nothing in the world is more important that an emotion that only you can feel.
en: SAPHIRA: Nothing in the world is more important that an emotion that only you can feel.
ja: サファイラ: この世界に、あなたにしか感じられない感情より大切なものなんてない。

key: Isn't that just another form of selfishness?
en: Isn't that just another form of selfishness?
ja: それってただの身勝手じゃないの?

key: SAPHIRA: But you chose this anyway.
en: SAPHIRA: But you chose this anyway.
ja: サファイラ: でも、あなたはそれでもこれを選んだ。

key: SAPHIRA: There's nothing wrong with striving for inner peace.
en: SAPHIRA: There's nothing wrong with striving for inner peace.
ja: サファイラ: 心の平穏を求めることに、何も悪いことはないわ。

key: If you could take a pill that made you feel at peace forever, with no side-effects, would you?
en: If you could take a pill that made you feel at peace forever, with no side-effects, would you?
ja: もし副作用なしで永遠に心が安らぐ薬があったら、あなたは飲む?

key: SAPHIRA: Because you don't think you can find it in the world.
en: SAPHIRA: Because you don't think you can find it in the world.
ja: サファイラ: この世界の中では見つけられないと思っているから、でしょう。

key: You give up a fight that no living man is permitted to quit.
en: You give up a fight that no living man is permitted to quit.
ja: 生きている限り誰も降りることを許されない戦いを、あなたは放棄している。

key: SAPHIRA: Then happiness itself is not what's important.
en: SAPHIRA: Then happiness itself is not what's important.
ja: サファイラ: それなら、幸福そのものが大切なわけじゃないのね。

key: What's important is your struggle to attain it.
en: What's important is your struggle to attain it.
ja: 大切なのは、それを手に入れようとするあなたの努力。

key: SAPHIRA: To favor that is to lose the forest for the trees.
en: SAPHIRA: To favor that is to lose the forest for the trees.
ja: サファイラ: それを優先するのは、木を見て森を見ないということ。

key: Currency is only as valuable as what else you could do with it.
en: Currency is only as valuable as what else you could do with it.
ja: お金の価値は、それで他に何ができるかによって決まる。

key: It is a tool to maintain freedom and control.
en: It is a tool to maintain freedom and control.
ja: それは自由と支配を保つための道具でしかない。

key: Isn't there another way to find those things?
en: Isn't there another way to find those things?
ja: それを手に入れる方法は、他にもあるんじゃないの?

key: SAPHIRA: But still you chose to focus on coin.
en: SAPHIRA: But still you chose to focus on coin.
ja: サファイラ: それでも、あなたはお金に目を向けることを選んだ。

key: Did you lack faith in your ability to reach that freedom, or did you just not care?
en: Did you lack faith in your ability to reach that freedom, or did you just not care?
ja: 自分の力でその自由を手に入れられると信じられなかったの、それともただ興味がなかっただけ?

key: SAPHIRA: To be alive is to fight for survival.
en: SAPHIRA: To be alive is to fight for survival.
ja: サファイラ: 生きるということは、生き残るために戦うということ。

key: To be human is to know inferiority.
en: To be human is to know inferiority.
ja: 人間であるということは、劣等を知るということ。

key: Even the confident will still perish.
en: Even the confident will still perish.
ja: どんなに自信のある者でも、いずれ滅びる。

key: Isn't that just what you told yourself so you never had to risk trying?
en: Isn't that just what you told yourself so you never had to risk trying?
ja: それって、挑戦する危険を冒さずに済むように、自分に言い聞かせてただけじゃないの?

key: In the end, you choose to buy that freedom with money instead of creating it inside yourself.
en: In the end, you choose to buy that freedom with money instead of creating it inside yourself.
ja: 結局あなたは、自分の内にその自由を作り出す代わりに、お金で買うことを選んだ。

key: That's the expensive route.
en: That's the expensive route.
ja: それは高くつく道よ。

key: Isn't it ironic how you force yourself to lose the thing you said you cared about most?
en: Isn't it ironic how you force yourself to lose the thing you said you cared about most?
ja: いちばん大切だと言っていたものを、自ら失うように仕向けるなんて、皮肉な話じゃない?

key: All because you didn't want to fight.
en: All because you didn't want to fight.
ja: 全部、戦いたくなかったから。

key: SAPHIRA: And how did you decide that?
en: SAPHIRA: And how did you decide that?
ja: サファイラ: それをどうやって判断したの?

key: One never knows if a lock matches a key until they open it.
en: One never knows if a lock matches a key until they open it.
ja: 鍵が合うかどうかは、開けてみるまで誰にも分からない。

key: Either the lock is sprung, or they give up looking.
en: Either the lock is sprung, or they give up looking.
ja: 錠が外れるか、探すのをあきらめるか、どちらかしかない。

key: Did you just convince yourself you had exhausted all your options to justify your resignation?
en: Did you just convince yourself you had exhausted all your options to justify your resignation?
ja: あきらめを正当化するために、選択肢を使い果たしたと自分に思い込ませただけじゃないの?

key: SAPHIRA: Because in the end, the illusion of freedom was more important to you than actually having it.
en: SAPHIRA: Because in the end, the illusion of freedom was more important to you than actually having it.
ja: サファイラ: 結局あなたにとっては、実際に自由を手にすることより、自由の幻想の方が大切だったから。

key: You are unwilling to fight, but unwilling to surrender.
en: You are unwilling to fight, but unwilling to surrender.
ja: 戦う気もなければ、降参する気もない。

key: That is your purgatory.
en: That is your purgatory.
ja: それがあなたのれんごく。

key: SAPHIRA: It can't be done because you decided it can't be done.
en: SAPHIRA: It can't be done because you decided it can't be done.
ja: サファイラ: できないのは、できないと自分で決めたから。

key: That is the power of your conviction.
en: That is the power of your conviction.
ja: それがあなたの思い込みの力。

key: That proves that you already have everything you need to cultivate that freedom within yourself.
en: That proves that you already have everything you need to cultivate that freedom within yourself.
ja: それはつまり、自分の中にその自由を育てるために必要なものを、あなたはもうすべて持っているという証拠。

key: You just choose not to use it because you'd rather blame your shortcomings on an economy rather than yourself.
en: You just choose not to use it because you'd rather blame your shortcomings on an economy rather than yourself.
ja: ただ、自分の欠点を自分自身ではなく経済のせいにしたいから、それを使わずにいるだけ。

key: You don't lack the ability to fight; only the backbone to.
en: You don't lack the ability to fight; only the backbone to.
ja: 戦う力が足りないんじゃない。戦う覚悟が足りないだけ。

key: SAPHIRA: Which is more important, your value to them or theirs to you?
en: SAPHIRA: Which is more important, your value to them or theirs to you?
ja: サファイラ: 大切なのは、あなたが彼らにとって価値があることと、彼らがあなたにとって価値があること、どちら?

key: SAPHIRA: Do you really believe you're that selfless?
en: SAPHIRA: Do you really believe you're that selfless?
ja: サファイラ: 自分がそんなに無欲だと、本気で思ってるの?

key: Having value to others is just a roundabout way of keeping yourself secure.
en: Having value to others is just a roundabout way of keeping yourself secure.
ja: 他人にとって価値があるというのは、遠回しに自分の身を守っているだけ。

key: Are you sure you even have value to them?
en: Are you sure you even have value to them?
ja: そもそも、あなたに彼らにとっての価値なんてあるの?

key: SAPHIRA: To be human is to know inferiority.
en: SAPHIRA: To be human is to know inferiority.
ja: サファイラ: 人間であるということは、劣等を知るということ。

key: Certainty is never just that-- only a point at which we've decided to stop pursuing a deeper truth.
en: Certainty is never just that-- only a point at which we've decided to stop pursuing a deeper truth.
ja: 確信というのは、ただそれだけのものじゃない――より深い真実を追い求めるのをやめると決めた、その一点に過ぎない。

key: It's when you stop fighting.
en: It's when you stop fighting.
ja: 戦うのをやめた、その瞬間のこと。

key: So you don't even know if the thing that's allegedly most important to you even exists.
en: So you don't even know if the thing that's allegedly most important to you even exists.
ja: だったら、あなたが一番大切だと言っているものが、そもそも存在するのかさえ分からないじゃない。

key: But still you stood there and said it.
en: But still you stood there and said it.
ja: それでもあなたはそこに立って、そう言った。

key: So, you're just fighting to make it true?
en: So, you're just fighting to make it true?
ja: それを本当にするために、戦っているだけなの?

key: So what really matters is what they can do for you.
en: So what really matters is what they can do for you.
ja: つまり本当に大切なのは、彼らがあなたに何をしてくれるかってこと。

key: Aren't you just using them?
en: Aren't you just using them?
ja: ただ利用してるだけじゃないの?

key: I hope you don't think that saying they're precious to you here makes up for that.
en: I hope you don't think that saying they're precious to you here makes up for that.
ja: ここで「大切だ」と言ったくらいで、それが帳消しになるなんて思わないでほしい。

key: Mutual care doesn't erase the utility they have to you, no matter how much of a blind eye you try to turn to it.
en: Mutual care doesn't erase the utility they have to you, no matter how much of a blind eye you try to turn to it.
ja: 互いに思いやっていたとしても、あなたにとっての利用価値が消えるわけじゃない。どれだけ見て見ぬふりをしても。

key: If you truly value them, make sure they understand it in your actions.
en: If you truly value them, make sure they understand it in your actions.
ja: 本当に大切に思ってるなら、行動でそれを分からせてあげなさい。

key: You have to fight for them as hard as they fight for you.
en: You have to fight for them as hard as they fight for you.
ja: 彼らがあなたのために戦うのと同じくらい、あなたも彼らのために戦わなきゃいけない。

key: SAPHIRA: So you can't decide?
en: SAPHIRA: So you can't decide?
ja: サファイラ: 決められないの?

key: But that's not in question.
en: But that's not in question.
ja: でも、それは問題じゃない。

key: So, which is it?
en: So, which is it?
ja: それで、どっちなの?

key: SAPHIRA: Not everyone is so lucky as to be blessed with relatives who share as much compassion as they do genetics.
en: SAPHIRA: Not everyone is so lucky as to be blessed with relatives who share as much compassion as they do genetics.
ja: サファイラ: 血のつながりと同じくらい思いやりも分かち合える身内に恵まれるなんて、誰もがそんな幸運を持てるわけじゃない。

key: Or did you just choose this because you thought it was what I would want to hear?
en: Or did you just choose this because you thought it was what I would want to hear?
ja: それとも、わたしが聞きたがってると思って、ただそれを選んだだけ?

key: SAPHIRA: A new truth cannot erase an old lie.
en: SAPHIRA: A new truth cannot erase an old lie.
ja: サファイラ: 新しい真実は、古いうそを消し去ったりしない。

key: You've chosen to prioritize me over your own values.
en: You've chosen to prioritize me over your own values.
ja: あなたは自分の価値観より、わたしを優先することを選んだ。

key: Is it just me, or do you treat everyone that way?
en: Is it just me, or do you treat everyone that way?
ja: それはわたしだけ?それとも誰にでもそうしてるの?

key: SAPHIRA: And yet you must know the contempt your saying so will breed.
en: SAPHIRA: And yet you must know the contempt your saying so will breed.
ja: サファイラ: それでも、そう言うことでどんな軽蔑を生むか、あなたは分かっているはずよ。

key: Maybe you learned your lesson, or maybe you just gave up.
en: Maybe you learned your lesson, or maybe you just gave up.
ja: 教訓を学んだのか、それともただあきらめただけなのか。

key: Maybe there's no difference.
en: Maybe there's no difference.
ja: 違いなんてないのかもしれない。

key: In the end, you'll still have to fight just like everyone else.
en: In the end, you'll still have to fight just like everyone else.
ja: 結局、あなたもみんなと同じように戦わなきゃいけなくなる。

key: Then who you are changes based on who you're facing.
en: Then who you are changes based on who you're facing.
ja: それなら、あなたが誰であるかは、向き合う相手によって変わるということ。

key: What is the difference between you and a mirror?
en: What is the difference between you and a mirror?
ja: それじゃあ、あなたと鏡と、何が違うの?

key: You have a chance to fight before you break.
en: You have a chance to fight before you break.
ja: 壊れる前に、戦う機会はまだある。

key: SAPHIRA: Would they still be the most important to you if you were never related at all?
en: SAPHIRA: Would they still be the most important to you if you were never related at all?
ja: サファイラ: もし血のつながりが一切なかったとしても、それでも彼らはあなたにとって一番大切な存在?

key: SAPHIRA: And perhaps that's the case.
en: SAPHIRA: And perhaps that's the case.
ja: サファイラ: たぶん、そうなんでしょうね。

key: They're no different than your friends in that case, right?
en: They're no different than your friends in that case, right?
ja: それなら、友達と何も変わらないでしょう?

key: They're people who you had the liberty to choose to fight for.
en: They're people who you had the liberty to choose to fight for.
ja: 彼らは、あなたが自分の意志で戦うと決められる相手ということ。

key: Not everyone is given that liberty.
en: Not everyone is given that liberty.
ja: 誰もがその自由を持っているわけじゃない。

key: SAPHIRA: Because you and them are uniquely made of something the rest of the world is not.
en: SAPHIRA: Because you and them are uniquely made of something the rest of the world is not.
ja: サファイラ: あなたと彼らは、他の誰にもない特別な何かでできているから。

key: You fight to protect what you are, not who you are.
en: You fight to protect what you are, not who you are.
ja: あなたは「誰であるか」ではなく、「何であるか」を守るために戦っている。

key: SAPHIRA: Freedom is air; we need it to live.
en: SAPHIRA: Freedom is air; we need it to live.
ja: サファイラ: 自由は空気。生きるために必要なもの。

key: But you do not treasure the air above all else.
en: But you do not treasure the air above all else.
ja: でも、空気を何よりも大切にするわけじゃない。

key: We take it for granted because to do otherwise in the face of its excess would shorten our lifespans in another way.
en: We take it for granted because to do otherwise in the face of its excess would shorten our lifespans in another way.
ja: それを当たり前だと思うのは、あり余るほどあるものをいちいち大切にしていたら、別の意味で寿命を縮めることになるから。

key: Is freedom different?
en: Is freedom different?
ja: 自由は違うの?

key: SAPHIRA: Then, like me, you have known what it is like to be without that air.
en: SAPHIRA: Then, like me, you have known what it is like to be without that air.
ja: サファイラ: それなら、わたしと同じように、あなたもその空気がない状態を知っているはずね。

key: Will there ever be a time when we do not need to grasp onto it so tightly?
en: Will there ever be a time when we do not need to grasp onto it so tightly?
ja: それをそんなにきつく握りしめずに済む時が、いつか来るのかしら。

key: SAPHIRA: But it will not come if we do not fight for it.
en: SAPHIRA: But it will not come if we do not fight for it.
ja: サファイラ: でも、そのために戦わなければ、その時は来ない。

key: SAPHIRA: Then we're the only ones prepared to survive.
en: SAPHIRA: Then we're the only ones prepared to survive.
ja: サファイラ: それなら、生き残る準備ができているのはわたしたちだけ。

key: In that sense, there was no other way this tournament could have ended.
en: In that sense, there was no other way this tournament could have ended.
ja: その意味で、このトーナメントがこれ以外の結末を迎えることはあり得なかった。

key: SAPHIRA: Then it should not need to be treasured.
en: SAPHIRA: Then it should not need to be treasured.
ja: サファイラ: それなら、大切にする必要なんてないはずね。

key: To prioritze freedom itself in its abudance is a symptom of indecision.
en: To prioritze freedom itself in its abudance is a symptom of indecision.
ja: 自由そのものが有り余っているのに、それを優先するのは優柔不断の表れ。

key: Is it a privilege or a weakness to leave that door eternally open?
en: Is it a privilege or a weakness to leave that door eternally open?
ja: その扉を永遠に開けたままにしておくのは、特権なの、それとも弱さなの?

key: It is a privilege few may have, but none should.
en: It is a privilege few may have, but none should.
ja: それは、ごく一部の者しか持ち得ない特権だけど、誰も持つべきではないもの。

key: Freedom of that kind is nothing short of stagnancy.
en: Freedom of that kind is nothing short of stagnancy.
ja: その種の自由は、停滞そのものでしかない。

key: To be alive is to fight for survival.
en: To be alive is to fight for survival.
ja: 生きるということは、生き残るために戦うということ。

key: Those who protect the privilege of stagnancy will always fail to do so.
en: Those who protect the privilege of stagnancy will always fail to do so.
ja: 停滞という特権を守ろうとする者は、いつだってそれに失敗する。

key: SAPHIRA: But still you leave it.
en: SAPHIRA: But still you leave it.
ja: サファイラ: それでも、あなたはそれを放っておく。

key: Did you give up on yourself already, or are you just waiting for a better time to start your life?
en: Did you give up on yourself already, or are you just waiting for a better time to start your life?
ja: もう自分に見切りをつけたの、それとも人生を始めるのにもっといい時を待っているだけ?

key: But nobody will wait for your answer.
en: But nobody will wait for your answer.
ja: でも、誰もあなたの答えを待ってはくれない。

key: There's no time like the present,
en: There's no time like the present,
ja: 今この瞬間より良い時なんてない。

key: Because there's no time but the present.
en: Because there's no time but the present.
ja: だって、今この瞬間しかないんだから。

key: No matter how weak they are, no one is exempt.
en: No matter how weak they are, no one is exempt.
ja: どれだけ弱くても、誰も免れることはできない。

key: SAPHIRA: Would you rather make a difference but be forgotten anyway, or change nothing but be remembered forever?
en: SAPHIRA: Would you rather make a difference but be forgotten anyway, or change nothing but be remembered forever?
ja: サファイラ: 何かを変えても忘れられるのと、何も変えなくても永遠に覚えていてもらえるのと、どちらがいい?

key: SAPHIRA: Altruism is a pleasant ideal, but ideals are inherently selfish.
en: SAPHIRA: Altruism is a pleasant ideal, but ideals are inherently selfish.
ja: サファイラ: 利他主義は心地よい理想だけど、理想というものは本質的に身勝手なもの。

key: The only thing your answer proves is that as much as your ego needs to be stroked, it doesn't have to be others that do it.
en: The only thing your answer proves is that as much as your ego needs to be stroked, it doesn't have to be others that do it.
ja: あなたの答えが証明しているのは、自分のエゴを満たしたいという気持ちがあっても、それをするのが他人である必要はないということだけ。

key: It's even more arrogant than just wanting to be remembered.
en: It's even more arrogant than just wanting to be remembered.
ja: ただ覚えていてほしいと願うより、よっぽど傲慢なことよ。

key: SAPHIRA: Because in the end, what matters is your ego.
en: SAPHIRA: Because in the end, what matters is your ego.
ja: サファイラ: 結局のところ、大切なのはあなたのエゴだから。

key: Would you presume you even know how to make a positive difference?
en: Would you presume you even know how to make a positive difference?
ja: 良い変化の起こし方を、自分が知っていると思い上がっているの?

key: SAPHIRA: Positive for who?
en: SAPHIRA: Positive for who?
ja: サファイラ: 誰にとっての「良い」なの?

key: Ideals are inherently selfish, and nothing is without underlying values.
en: Ideals are inherently selfish, and nothing is without underlying values.
ja: 理想は本質的に身勝手なもので、根底にある価値観と無縁のものなんてない。

key: The only thing you can do, no matter what you think or try, is push your own perspective onto the world.
en: The only thing you can do, no matter what you think or try, is push your own perspective onto the world.
ja: あなたが何を考えて何をしようとも、できることはただひとつ。自分の視点を世界に押しつけることだけ。

key: Even children are just an opinion that has taken on its own shape.
en: Even children are just an opinion that has taken on its own shape.
ja: 子供でさえ、ひとつの意見が形をとったものにすぎない。

key: But that is the way of it.
en: But that is the way of it.
ja: でも、それがものごとのあり方。

key: Everyone fights for the survival of ideas.
en: Everyone fights for the survival of ideas.
ja: 誰もが、考えを生き残らせるために戦っている。

key: SAPHIRA: But against all logic, your priority is still to try.
en: SAPHIRA: But against all logic, your priority is still to try.
ja: サファイラ: それでも、あらゆる理屈に反して、あなたはまだ挑むことを優先している。

key: Persistence is not condemnable, but foolhardiness is.
en: Persistence is not condemnable, but foolhardiness is.
ja: 粘り強さは責められることじゃない。でも無謀さは違う。

key: Where among those you fall is yet to be proven.
en: Where among those you fall is yet to be proven.
ja: あなたがそのどちらなのかは、まだ証明されていない。

key: SAPHIRA: Nothing.
en: SAPHIRA: Nothing.
ja: サファイラ: 何もない。

key: You got this far with no ambitions.
en: You got this far with no ambitions.
ja: 野心もなく、ここまでたどり着いたの。

key: Just for kicks?
en: Just for kicks?
ja: ただの気晴らし?

key: Entertainment is a tool for happiness.
en: Entertainment is a tool for happiness.
ja: 娯楽は幸福のための道具。

key: To see if you could?
en: To see if you could?
ja: できるかどうか、試したかっただけ?

key: Doesn't that make it about your ego?
en: Doesn't that make it about your ego?
ja: それって結局、あなたのエゴの話にならない?

key: Maybe because of those around you?
en: Maybe because of those around you?
ja: もしかして、周りの人たちのため?

key: Did you really listen to them talk all this time without caring at all?
en: Did you really listen to them talk all this time without caring at all?
ja: ずっと彼らの話を聞いていて、本当に何も気にかけてこなかったの?

key: To say "Nothing" is either laziness or fear.
en: To say "Nothing" is either laziness or fear.
ja: 「何もない」と答えるのは、怠惰か、恐れのどちらか。

key: Do you want to give that another try?
en: Do you want to give that another try?
ja: もう一度、考え直してみる?

key: SAPHIRA: Fine.
en: SAPHIRA: Fine.
ja: サファイラ: いいわ。

key: No matter how little it may be... what is most precious to you?
en: No matter how little it may be... what is most precious to you?
ja: どんなにささいなことでもいい……あなたにとって一番大切なものは何?

key: SAPHIRA: It's only easiest to answer nothing when you're afraid of others, or of yourself knowing the truth.
en: SAPHIRA: It's only easiest to answer nothing when you're afraid of others, or of yourself knowing the truth.
ja: サファイラ: 「何もない」が一番答えやすいのは、他人が怖いか、自分が真実を知ることが怖いか、そのどちらかのときだけ。

key: So which is it?
en: So which is it?
ja: それで、どっち?

key: SAPHIRA: Do you really think anybody cares?
en: SAPHIRA: Do you really think anybody cares?
ja: サファイラ: 誰かが本当に気にかけてくれるとでも思ってるの?

key: Or are you afraid of what you choose being used against you?
en: Or are you afraid of what you choose being used against you?
ja: それとも、自分が選んだものが自分に不利に使われるのが怖いの?

key: That is not a baseless fear.
en: That is not a baseless fear.
ja: それは根拠のない恐れじゃない。

key: The world is out to get you, but it is not out to get YOU.
en: The world is out to get you, but it is not out to get YOU.
ja: 世界はあなたを狙っている。でも、「あなた」個人を狙っているわけじゃない。

key: But even fear, that extreme way of protecting yourself, is just another way to fight.
en: But even fear, that extreme way of protecting yourself, is just another way to fight.
ja: でも恐れも――自分を守るための極端な手段も、結局はひとつの戦い方でしかない。

key: SAPHIRA: You won't acknowledge that you care about anything, because you can't stand the pain that brings.
en: SAPHIRA: You won't acknowledge that you care about anything, because you can't stand the pain that brings.
ja: サファイラ: あなたが何かを大切に思っていると認めないのは、それがもたらす痛みに耐えられないから。

key: How badly have you been burned?
en: How badly have you been burned?
ja: どれほどひどく傷ついたの?

key: A child learns quickly not to touch a raging fire.
en: A child learns quickly not to touch a raging fire.
ja: 子供は、燃え盛る火に触れてはいけないとすぐに学ぶ。

key: It takes an adult to be willing to put it out.
en: It takes an adult to be willing to put it out.
ja: でも、それを進んで消そうとするには、大人にならなきゃいけない。

key: When will you grow up?
en: When will you grow up?
ja: いつ大人になるつもり?

key: When will you start fighting?
en: When will you start fighting?
ja: いつ戦い始めるつもり?

key: No matter.
en: No matter.
ja: ……もういいわ。

key: It's time for it to begin again.
en: It's time for it to begin again.
ja: また始める時間よ。

key: SAPHIRA: Your precious thing is inside that chest.
en: SAPHIRA: Your precious thing is inside that chest.
ja: サファイラ: あなたの大切なものは、あの宝箱の中。

key: The world does not want you to keep it.
en: The world does not want you to keep it.
ja: 世界はあなたにそれを持たせたくない。

key: Threats will approach from all sides.
en: Threats will approach from all sides.
ja: 脅威はあらゆる方向から迫ってくる。

key: Eliminate them before they reach their goal.
en: Eliminate them before they reach their goal.
ja: 目的を果たされる前に、それを排除しなさい。

key: Here are the rules:
en: Here are the rules:
ja: ルールはこう：

key: If you want something, fight for it.
en: If you want something, fight for it.
ja: 何かが欲しいなら、それのために戦うこと。

key: There are no breaks.
en: There are no breaks.
ja: 休憩はない。

key: There are no second chances.
en: There are no second chances.
ja: やり直しはない。

key: There are no other rules.
en: There are no other rules.
ja: それ以外のルールはない。

key: Good luck.
en: Good luck.
ja: 幸運を。

key: (It is suggested to turn Speed-Up Mode off for this challenge.)
en: (It is suggested to turn Speed-Up Mode off for this challenge.)
ja: （このチャレンジでは、スピードアップモードをオフにすることを推奨する。）

key: SAPHIRA: I did say there were no second chances.
en: SAPHIRA: I did say there were no second chances.
ja: サファイラ: やり直しはないと言ったはずよ。

key: Your journey would have been over,
en: Your journey would have been over,
ja: あなたの旅はここで終わっていたはず。

key: But I am not as cruel as the world.
en: But I am not as cruel as the world.
ja: でも、わたしは世界ほど残酷じゃない。

key: Do you need me to clarify the game?
en: Do you need me to clarify the game?
ja: ルールをもう一度説明してほしい?

key: SAPHIRA: Do you need me to clarify the game?
en: SAPHIRA: Do you need me to clarify the game?
ja: サファイラ: ルールをもう一度説明してほしい?

key: There are no second chances-- not out there.
en: There are no second chances-- not out there.
ja: やり直しはない――外の世界では。

key: Begin.
en: Begin.
ja: 始めなさい。

key: SAPHIRA: Then learn from your mistakes.
en: SAPHIRA: Then learn from your mistakes.
ja: サファイラ: それなら、自分の失敗から学びなさい。

key: You're full of them.
en: You're full of them.
ja: あなたには失敗がたくさんある。

key: And thus, you are full of strength.
en: And thus, you are full of strength.
ja: だからこそ、あなたには強さもたくさんある。

key: Gym Puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Gym Puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブファイルで、このジムパズルのクリアが確認された。

key: Skip defending the treasure chest on this file?
en: Skip defending the treasure chest on this file?
ja: このファイルでは、宝箱を守るチャレンジをスキップしますか?

key: Blaziken is revving up speed!
en: Blaziken is revving up speed!
ja: バシャーモがスピードを上げている!

key: Something is lifting the treasure away!
en: Something is lifting the treasure away!
ja: 何かがお宝を持ち去ろうとしている!

key: The chest was blown back to where it started!
en: The chest was blown back to where it started!
ja: 宝箱が吹き飛ばされ、元の場所に戻された!

key: Garchomp is preparing to rush!
en: Garchomp is preparing to rush!
ja: ガブリアスが突進の構えを見せている!

key: ...GRRRAAAAWWWWRR...!
en: ...GRRRAAAAWWWWRR...!
ja: ……グルルアアアアアウウウルルル……!

key: SAPHIRA: Is that the best you can do?
en: SAPHIRA: Is that the best you can do?
ja: サファイラ: それが精一杯なの?

key: However many enemies you take out makes no difference if you still fail to protect what matters.
en: However many enemies you take out makes no difference if you still fail to protect what matters.
ja: どれだけ敵を倒しても、大切なものを守れなければ意味がない。

key: Learn your enemies' movements and predict, rather than react to, them.
en: Learn your enemies' movements and predict, rather than react to, them.
ja: 敵の動きを見極め、反応するのではなく先読みしなさい。

key: You are the offensive; not them.
en: You are the offensive; not them.
ja: 攻めるのはあなたであって、彼らじゃない。

key: When it's all said and done, no excuse will bring what's lost back to you.
en: When it's all said and done, no excuse will bring what's lost back to you.
ja: すべてが終わったとき、どんな言い訳をしても失ったものは戻ってこない。

key: No reason is good enough to undo failure.
en: No reason is good enough to undo failure.
ja: どんな理由も、失敗を帳消しにするには足りない。

key: I pity any damsel fate would thrust into your care.
en: I pity any damsel fate would thrust into your care.
ja: あなたに守られることになった令嬢がいるとしたら、気の毒に思うわ。

key: None of us begin with the ability to protect even ourselves.
en: None of us begin with the ability to protect even ourselves.
ja: 誰も、最初から自分自身すら守る力を持って生まれてくるわけじゃない。

key: The world teaches it to us through necessity, with every sling and arrow it can muster.
en: The world teaches it to us through necessity, with every sling and arrow it can muster.
ja: 世界はあらゆる苦難をもって、必要に迫られる形でそれを教えてくれる。

key: Now it is your turn to learn.
en: Now it is your turn to learn.
ja: 今度はあなたが学ぶ番。

key: Which do you blame for your failure, the circumstances or your shortcomings?
en: Which do you blame for your failure, the circumstances or your shortcomings?
ja: 自分の失敗を、状況のせいにする?それとも自分の欠点のせいにする?

key: It won't change the outcome-- only who you have to forgive.
en: It won't change the outcome-- only who you have to forgive.
ja: 結果は変わらない――変わるのは、誰を許さなきゃいけないかだけ。

key: Again.
en: Again.
ja: もう一度。

key: The world... is tilting.
en: The world... is tilting.
ja: 世界が……傾いている。

key: The treasure will be ours eventually!
en: The treasure will be ours eventually!
ja: お宝はいずれ俺たちのものだ!

key: Once, I was a dread guard... But now, I'm just a dead guard.
en: Once, I was a dread guard... But now, I'm just a dead guard.
ja: かつて俺は恐るべき番人だった……だが今は、ただの死せる番人だ。

key: How long do you really think you can hold out?
en: How long do you really think you can hold out?
ja: どれだけ持ちこたえられると思ってる?
